name: WT Delay
description: Live wavetable-capture stereo delay with gated 64-frame FIFO, ZOH playback, BPM-synced delayed echo trails, and dry/wet mix.

params.name: Rate
params.explanation: Frame capture rate into the 64-frame FIFO (0 = slow ~370 ms snapshots, 100 = continuous 5.8 ms slices).

params.name: Pitch
params.explanation: Wavetable playback pitch in semitones (-24 to +24 st; 0 = native 1x speed).

params.name: Time
params.explanation: Delay time: 40..700 ms (clicks 0..660), then 1/16..1/4. synced to pedal BPM (665 = 1/8.).

params.name: Depth
params.explanation: Wavetable frame-scan drift around each echo's sampled frame (0 = exact sampled frame, 100 = wide history scan).

params.name: Mode
params.explanation: History scan shape (SAW = backward trail sweep, STEP = 4-step rhythmic, TRI = ping-pong drift, RND = random scatter).

params.name: Decay
params.explanation: Echo repeat feedback / decay (0 = single brief echo, 100 = long fading wavetable delay trails).

params.name: Tone
params.explanation: Wet wavetable low-pass filter cutoff (warm dark pad to raw ZOH aliasing).

params.name: Mix
params.explanation: Dry/Wet delay mix (0 = dry, 50 = balanced blend, 100 = 100% wet stereo send).

params.name: Level
params.explanation: Master stereo output level (80 is unity).
